title: Customer Success 1:1 — cheat sheet & follow-ups
body:
Purpose / framing:
- Quick prep notes for my weekly AE/CSM 1:1 with Julian (AE) — keep it under 30m, prioritize escalations and high-leverage next steps.
- Use as a one-pager I can scan 5 min before the call.

Agenda (target: 25–30m):
1) Quick sync (3m): what changed in the account slate since last week? wins/losses.
2) Top customer escalations (8–10m): where we need AE/SE support or exec engagement.
3) Expansion opps (6m): signals, next outreach, cadence.
4) Operational blockers (5m): billing, infra, SLOs, rollouts.
5) Commitments & owners (3m): confirm next steps, deadlines.

Top accounts to call out (notes to self):
- KineticRetail (priority: mid-market retail chain)
  - Health: degraded after model upgrade (v2.3 quantized). Customers seeing hallucination spike on product recommendations.
  - Last week: infra rollbacks mitigated latency but not quality.
  - Ask AE: coordinate a joint SE-led investigation this week; propose reverting model or A/B with tuned prompt set.
  - Short-term owner: Julian; SE: Connor; my ask: schedule canary run by Wed EOD.

- Nimbus Analytics (expansion target)
  - Health: stable; usage modest but steadily growing. Executive sponsor receptive to dedicated offering if we can show 20% cost savings.
  - Next step: build a short ROI calc (tokens/month -> dedicated commit savings).
  - Action: I will draft ROI bullets; ask AE to open discovery with procurement (intro email template below).

- Helix Pharma (SLA/compliance)
  - Concern: wants on-prem/private deployment proof-of-concept; legal asked for audit trail samples.
  - Trigger: refer to Private team checklist; copy security&compliance.
  - Owner: me to coordinate POC scoping; engineering lead contact: Sophie.

Open escalations / blocking items (to raise):
- Billing dispute: KineticRetail overcharged for burst on 2026-03-02 (ticket JIRA-5721). Need billing team ETA.
- Dedicated capacity quota: Nimbus wants to lock in a Q2 commit — procurement needs pricing sketch and uplift options.
- Model rollback process: ensure rollback path documented (link to RFC in linked artifacts).

Conversation prompts / talk tracks:
- "Quick health check: what metric would you show the exec at this moment?" (forces concise ask).
- For escalation: "If we don't fix this in 72 hours, what's the customer impact? What resources do we need?"
- For expansion: "What's the smallest pilot we can sell that proves cost benefit in 30 days?"

Short scripts / email templates (to copy after call):
- Intro to procurement (Nimbus):
  Hi [Procurement Name],
  Julian and I had a quick sync — Nimbus is exploring a small Dedicated pilot. Attached is a one-page cost comparison and a 30-day pilot plan. Can you share available windows for procurement review?
  Best, Aisha

- SE ask (KineticRetail):
  Connor — can we schedule 1–2 hours to run through the failing prompt cases and test a conservative revert to non-quantized model? Ideally Wed morning. I’ll bring customer logs and prompt examples.

Notes to self (scratch):
- Bring sample hallucination examples to call. Use 3–5 canonical prompts that reproduce the issue.
- Pull token/cost delta from Console for KineticRetail (need last 30 days).
- Check if rollback affects latency SLA — coordinate with infra/sre.
- Double-check access for Helix's security team to audit logs (may need signed NDA).

Follow-ups and owners (capture here during call):
- KineticRetail: schedule SE deep-dive by Wed EOD (owner: Julian + Connor) — due 2026-03-11.
- Billing: escalated to Billing team (owner: Aisha) — ask for resolution by 2026-03-15. Link: JIRA-5721.
- Nimbus ROI one-pager: draft (owner: Aisha) — due 2026-03-13; AE to provide usage profile by EOD today.
- Helix POC scope doc: initial outline (owner: Sophie) — due 2026-03-18.

Risks / things to watch:
- If SE time > 4h for KineticRetail, may need to propose paid engagement; flag to Julian.
- Legal's timeline for Helix could push POC by 2–3 weeks; pre-empt with partial data sample.

Quick checklist before call (5 min):
- [ ] Open JIRA tickets referenced (billing + infra).
- [ ] Pull top-3 failing prompts and attach to calendar invite.
- [ ] Confirm SE and AE calendar availability for canary run.
- [ ] Prep the ROI bullet points (one paragraph).

After-call template (to send within 30m):
- Short subject: "Recap + agreed actions — 1:1 with Julian (Aisha)"
- Body: bullets: 1) decisions, 2) actions + owner + due date, 3) any blockers and requests (e.g., billing ETA).

Unresolved questions to bring up with product/engineering this week:
- Do we have a documented fallback path for quantization rollbacks that preserves customer session continuity?
- Can we get a quick runbook for on-prem audit artifact exports (Helix ask)?

Random thoughts / brainstorms (private):
- Could create a one-click "request SE deep-dive" flow in Console that auto-opens a joint calendar + attaches last-7d logs. High friction now.
- Distill ROI template into a single table: current spend, projected spend on Dedicated, delta and payback period (this sells).

End of page.

(keep this doc portable — copy-paste the parts I need into meeting invite and follow-up email)
